title: Lithuanian–Muscovite War (1487–1494)
text: The Lithuanian-Muscovite War of 1487–1494 was the war of the Principality of Moscow, in alliance with the Crimean Khanate, against the Grand Duchy of Lithuania in alliance with the Golden Horde Khan Akhmat, and united by personal union with the Kingdom of Poland under the leadership of Grand Duke Casimir IV Jagiellon.
